{{Top|leg}}
A '''balance turbine''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] component designed to distribute the energy from the repulsorlift evenly around the craft. This in turn allows the engine to move heavy weights, but does not provide speed.
